LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.Settings.DefaultAutoRel: Enable auto-reload by default on new packs
If enabled, automatic reloading will be turned on by default for new packs.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.Settings.AutoReloadWhen: Reload while drafted (only if components are in inventory)

If enabled, drafted colonists will automatically reload the pack during idle moments, but only if they have enough industrial components in their inventory (they will not leave their position to visit a stockpile).
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.ManualDeploy.Desc: Launch an extinguisher drone capsule to the target location to extinguish a fire.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoDeploy.Desc: Toggle automatic deployment of the extinguisher drone when fire is detected within {0} cells.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoReload.Desc: Toggle automatic reloading of the pack with industrial components.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoReload.DescOnPeace: Auto-reload is ON: the wearer will automatically reload the pack when undrafted.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoReload.DescOnCombat: Auto-reload is ON: the wearer will reload the pack (while drafted, only if components are in inventory).
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.AutoReload.DescOff: Auto-reload is OFF: the wearer will only reload the pack on command.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.ManualReload.Desc: Order the wearer to find industrial components and reload the pack.
LanguageData.ExtinguisherPack.NoAmmo: Not enough resources ({0}) to reload the pack.
